lead.headline: Outside money beat the candidate's own spending in 104 of 637 congressional campaigns in 2024; Moreno tops at 5.8x
lead.number: 104 of 637 matched 2024 House and Senate candidates saw more outside spending than their own (82 over $1M); Moreno $152M outside vs $26M own.
